content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Bakersfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific thresholds based on your bachelor's degree status and hours of documented project work. Contact Granite PM Academy if you need guidance interpreting your background against PMI standards.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam-domain deep dives. Schedule your cohort start date around your work calendar in Bakersfield.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and complete your official PMP application, documenting your project experience and education. Submit your fee to activate your candidacy. Granite PM Academy staff can clarify application requirements and help you gather supporting documentation before you submit to PMI.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Leverage Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions, to build confidence before exam day. Schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. You may test at an authorized center in Bakersfield or online, depending on your preference.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout your three-year renewal cycle by completing PMI-approved training, project work, and professional activities. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses and workshops to help Bakersfield professionals keep their certification current and stay competitive.
